meta.title: Petaloff — fullstack developer
meta.description: Hi, I'm Petaloff. I write Discord bots, Minecraft mods and plugins on Fabric and Paper, and the odd Next.js site. Here are my projects, how they work, and a devlog.

hero.title: I write Discord bots and Minecraft mods
hero.lead: I like bots that quietly run on a thousand servers and mods you want to install twice. That's what I make.

about.title: About
about.body: It started with Minecraft: first I poked at other people's plugins, then I started writing my own. Then came Discord bots for friends, which slowly grew into a real backend. These days I write Fabric mods, Paper plugins and sometimes sites like this one. My favourite part is making something complicated feel simple.
about.status: What I'm up to on Discord

stack.title: Stack
stack.lead: What I write with every day and trust in production.

blog.title: Blog
blog.lead: I write about what I'm building: what broke, how I fixed it and what I learned on the way. Each post is in whichever language fits.
blog.empty: Nothing written yet, but it's coming.

contact.title: Let's talk
contact.lead: Got an idea, a bug, or just want to chat? Message me on Discord or Telegram, that's where I answer fastest.

mode.hint: This is the light version. Want the cubes? Turn on 3D up top.

consent.text: Mind if I see how you use the site? Anonymously, with PostHog: clicks, scrolling, device. If not, only a simple cookie-free counter runs.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: What this site collects, honestly: anonymous stats, PostHog only if you say yes, Discord status and comments.

minecraft.title: Minecraft
minecraft.lead: Here's my skin and the server where I test my mods before release.

now.title: Now
now.lead: What I'm busy with right now. I update it when things change.

changelog.title: Changelog
changelog.lead: All my releases in one place: mods from Modrinth and projects from GitHub. The feed refreshes hourly.
changelog.empty: No releases yet, or Modrinth and GitHub aren't answering right now.
